name: sub-agent
description: Spawn child agents for parallel task execution

apiKey.description: OpenAI-compatible API key for the sub-agent LLM. Must be set for the extension to function.
apiKey.label: API Key

model.description: LLM model identifier (e.g., gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-20250514, gemini-2.5-pro)
model.label: Model

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API endpoint
baseUrl.label: API Base URL

maxTokens.description: Maximum completion tokens per LLM response
maxTokens.label: Max Tokens

maxTurns.description: Default max reasoning turns per sub-agent run (1-10, default: 3). More turns = deeper analysis but more cost.
maxTurns.label: Default Max Turns
